Jules Park: FYI hiring teamandidate Arjun Patel (applied SWE II) is in Mumbai (IST, GMT+5:30). He's available Tue May 3 between 17:00-21:00 IST (07:30-11:30 PT) or Wed May 4 09:00-12:00 IST (23:30-02:30 PT). He requested wheelchair access for onsite and prefers a quiet room due to neurodivergent accommodations. Also asked if we can reimburse a taxi (~₹1,200). Can people-ops help coordinate?
Evan Li: We prefer Tue morning PT (07:30-11:30 PT) window. Team availability: Evan (HM) 08:00-11:00 PT, Sumi (Backend) 07:30-09:00 PT, Alex (Infra) 09:00-11:00 PT, Pri (PM) 08:00-09:00 PT. Want a 3x40m interview loop + 30m recruiter debrief, then optional 45m onsite visit if screening passes.
Rhea Sundar: I can handle accessibility and reimbursements. For wheelchair access I need office floor and arrival ETA to prereg to security and ensure elevator access. Office has a quiet room (Room 3B) we can reserve. Which office location?
Jules Park: We'll use Mountain View office (Building C). ETA if onsite would be ~15:30 local (PT) same day as remote. Candidate asked if we can provide a campus shuttle drop-off note.
Kate Morgan: @Rhea I can reserve Room 3B and flag security. To prereg a guest I need full name as on ID, email, arrival time and whether they need a printed badge. We can add shuttle instructions and mark the route as wheelchair accessible. Parking note: we have a curbside drop zone but no long-term guest parking without prior approval.
Jules Park: Arjun's details: arjun.patel@example.com, passport name Arjun Ramesh Patel, +91 98200 33444. He prefers printed badge and curb drop. He
lso asked about reimbursement process and whether remote interviewers should use captions. He said he uses live captions.
people-ops-bot: Accessibility tip: if candidate requests real-time captions, add note to interview invites "Live captions available on Zoom; please enable live transcript." For sign-language interpreter requests, submit two weeks' notice to accessibility@redwood.com. Reimbursement quick guide: domestic taxi under $50: upload receipt to expenses@redwood.com with tag `interview-travel`. Link: https://intranet.redwood/people-ops/reimbursements
Rhea Sundar: I'll prereg badge and request Room 3B at 15:00-16:00 PT as quiet recovery space. I'll also arrange for a printed badge and mark the guest as wheelchair assistance required. Will we provide a loaner laptop?
Evan Li: Not necessary unless candidate asks. Jules, please ask if they need one. Also can someone draft the calendar copy that mentions captions and quiet room?
Jules Park: Draft calendar copy below, please adapt: ```Remote loop (Zoom) 07:30-10:00 PT: 3 x 40m interviews + 30m recruiter debrief. If candidate chooses onsite visit, please RSVP to the in-person block at 15:00 PT. Quiet room (Room 3B) reserved for decompression. Live captions enabled on Zoom. Contact on arrival: Kate Morgan at +1 650-555-0102.```
Kate Morgan: Room 3B reserved for 14:45-16:15 PT. Security flagged printed badge and curb drop. I'll place a note at reception to escort. Shuttle: we can add the campus shuttle schedule to the invite.
Jules Park: I messaged Arjun to confirm whether he wants the onsite portion. Also asked about taxi receipt upload method.
Arjun Patel (via Jules): Thanks everyone. I'll do the remote loop and decide about onsite after the first two interviews. I will likely need the quiet room. I will keep a taxi receipt and share it after travel.
Rhea Sundar: Action items: Kate to confirm reception escort + shuttle note, Rhea to prereg badge and add accessibility flags, Jules to finalize invites with captions note and receipt instructions, Evan to prepare the screening question to decide on onsite. Please close loops by EOD Thu.
Evan Li: I'll put a 10m check at the end of the second interview to quickly evaluate for onsite.
people-ops-bot: Note saved to candidate profile: "Arjun Patel  wheelchair access; quiet room requested; printed badge; captions enabled; taxi reimbursement guidance sent."
Jules Park: Candidate confirmed receipt of calendar and captions note :white_check_mark: Thanks all, will follow up if he opts for onsite.
